privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What Orkhon collects, why, who processes it and how to delete it.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Orkhon collects, why we collect it and what you can do about it. It covers the website at orkhon.beishang.dev and the app at app.orkhon.beishang.dev.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Orkhon is built and operated by beishang.dev, an independent developer based in Turkey. We are the data controller for the data described here. You can reach us at contact@beishang.dev.

sections.title: What we collect
items: Account details: your email address, name and preferred language. Passwords are stored only as an Argon2id hash, never in plain text.
Google or GitHub sign-in: if you choose it, we receive your name, email address, profile picture and the account ID from that provider. We do not get your Google or GitHub password.
Sessions: for each signed-in device we keep the IP address, browser user agent and device name, so we can protect your account and show you where you are signed in.

Connected services: the access tokens and API keys you add (for example Vercel, Coolify, GitHub, Stripe, Supabase or a database). They are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, never shown back in plain text and never written to logs.
Workspace data: what Orkhon reads from those services on your behalf (deployments, CI runs, revenue figures, logs, database metadata) and what you enter yourself (expenses, notes, settings).
Website forms: the email address and message you send through the contact or early access form. They are delivered to us by email.
Billing: if you buy a paid plan, Stripe processes the payment. We receive your plan, payment status and limited billing details, never your full card number.

sections.title: How we use it
items: To run Orkhon and show you the data you asked it to monitor.
To keep accounts secure, for example by detecting unusual sign-ins and limiting repeated login attempts.
To send service emails: email verification, password reset, invitations and billing notices.
To answer your messages and support requests.
paragraphs: We do not sell your data, show ads or use third-party advertising trackers.

sections.title: AI features
paragraphs: When you use the AI assistant, your question and the workspace context it needs are sent to an AI provider: Google Gemini by default, or the provider whose key you added (OpenAI, Anthropic or DeepSeek). This happens only when you use the assistant. Those providers process the data under their own terms.

sections.title: Who processes data for us
items: Hostinger: the server that runs the Orkhon app, API and database.
Vercel: hosting for this website.
Resend: delivery of service emails and website form messages.
Stripe: payments for paid plans.
Google and GitHub: sign-in, only if you choose them.
The AI providers listed above, only when you use the assistant.
paragraphs: Some of these providers process data outside Turkey. We use them only to run the service, and they may not use your data for their own purposes.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
paragraphs: This website remembers your theme and language. The app keeps your sign-in tokens in your browser so you stay signed in. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep account and workspace data while your account is active. When you ask us to delete your account, we delete it and your workspace data within 30 days, except records the law requires us to keep, such as invoices. Website form messages are kept only as long as we need them to reply.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK, No. 6698), and the GDPR where it applies, you can ask to see, correct, export or delete your data, and you can object to how we use it. Email contact@beishang.dev and we will reply within 30 days. You can also complain to the Personal Data Protection Authority (KVKK) or your local data protection authority.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: All traffic uses TLS. Secrets are encrypted, passwords are hashed and each workspace's data is kept separate. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects your data, we will tell you as the law requires.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: Orkhon is not meant for anyone under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their data.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: When this policy changes, we update the date at the top. For significant changes we also email account holders before they take effect.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use Orkhon, the website at orkhon.beishang.dev and the app at app.orkhon.beishang.dev, operated by beishang.dev. By creating an account or using Orkhon you agree to them.

sections.title: Early access
paragraphs: Orkhon is in early access. Features may change, be limited or be unavailable at times, and we do not guarantee a specific uptime yet.

sections.title: Your account
items: You must be at least 16 years old.
Give accurate information and keep your sign-in details safe.
You are responsible for what happens under your account. Tell us at once if you think someone else has access to it.

sections.title: Your data and connected services
paragraphs: Your data stays yours. When you connect a service, you allow Orkhon to access it only to provide the features you use. Connect only services and accounts you have the right to use. You can disconnect a service at any time.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Do not use Orkhon to:
items: break the law or the terms of a service you connect;
probe, scan or attack systems you do not own or have permission to test;
get around plan limits, security controls or access restrictions;
put unreasonable load on the service or interfere with other users;
resell or redistribute the service without our written permission.

sections.title: Plans and payment
paragraphs: Paid plans are billed in advance for each billing period through Stripe. You can cancel at any time; the plan stays active until the end of the paid period. We will tell you before a price change takes effect. Refunds follow the law that applies to you.

sections.title: AI assistant
paragraphs: AI answers can be wrong or incomplete. Check them before you act on them, especially before deployments, database changes or anything you cannot undo. You are responsible for the actions you take.

sections.title: No warranty
paragraphs: Orkhon is provided as is. To the extent the law allows, we make no promises that it will be uninterrupted, error-free or fit for a particular purpose.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses such as lost profits or lost data. Our total liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have as a consumer that cannot be limited by contract.

sections.title: Ending your use
paragraphs: You can stop using Orkhon and ask us to delete your account at any time. We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms; where possible we will tell you first and explain why.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms. For significant changes we will email account holders before they take effect. If you keep using Orkhon after that, the new terms apply.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey, and the courts of Turkey have jurisdiction, without affecting any mandatory consumer protection rules of your country.
